summary: Chased the config-change refusal anomaly: when a leader already has a pending change, the extra configuration-change entry is reported as dropped (client gets Dropped via the dropped-entry list) and replaced with a zero-valued application entry, which Entry.IsEmpty classifies as empty and the replicated state machine routes to its noop handler — applied index advances, user Update is never called. Recorded one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account noting the extra committed no-op slot. No execution requested.
